added: Approve the run by 9 am ET on a business day and each payment lands that day in the person’s own time zone. The run lists every landing time before you approve.

log.action: Which exchange rate do my people get?
added: The mid-market rate at the moment you approve, with no FX markup. The rate locks for that run, and each payslip shows it with the time it was locked.

log.action: Does Ferry employ my people or file thei
added: No. Ferry pays the people you already employ or contract with; it is not an employer of record. Local tax filings stay with your accountant or payroll provider, and Ferry gives them a file of every payment.

log.action: How do I fund the balance?
added: In US dollars, by ACH or wire. A wire arrives the same business day; ACH takes 1 to 3 business days, so fund ahead of payday. The run will not let you approve more than your balance.
$12 per person a month, first 3 people free. You pay only for people paid that month. No FX markup, no setup fee and no transfer fees.
In a segregated account at a US partner bank, kept apart from Ferry’s own money. Your balance is only used for the runs you approve.

log.action: Can we leave whenever we want?
added: Yes. Cancel online at any time, and export every run, rate and payslip as CSV first. Any money left in your balance goes back to your bank account.
